Name: Just Saying Hi
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4][quote]Hi Abigail! Bye Abigail![/quote][/size]
[b]Just say Hi without stopping for a full conversation![/b]

[b]The first time you interact with an NPC each day, a quick "bubble hello" will trigger above the NPC instead.[/b]
• You'll receive half the friendship points of a full conversation.
• You can still talk to the NPC afterwards like normal.
• Good for those times you don't want to stop to chat, but still want to gain a little friendship.
• Amount of friendship points given can be changed in the config.
[b]
Greetings are slightly varied, and based on:[/b]
• Time of day and heart level (getting more personal/unique at higher hearts).
• Time of day + if you're dating the NPC.
• Time of day + if you're married to the NPC.
• If you're married to the NPC + it's a festival day.
• Low chance for lines about the weather.

[b]Things to note:
[/b]• Greetings won’t trigger until after you’ve officially met an NPC.
• Greetings are meant to be short and simple, since they're in chat-bubble style. Some are a bit longer to try to make them unique where I could. Let me know if anything feels too wordy, if higher hearts entries feel repetitive, or if you find spelling/grammar errors; lines were a lot to keep track of.
• Only base game NPCs are included by default, although greetings can be made for new NPCs by adding them to the default.json. Greeting count can also go up to 9, but most stop at 4 for my sanity's sake.
(Yoba have mercy on anyone who attempts to translate this.)

[b]Works with mouse and controller![/b]

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+  
• SMAPI  

(Mods in screenshot: Stardew Valley Expanded, Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch., VPR-Inspired UI, Peachy Objects)
